mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the first landing skid was the clearest construction change: the added bar and posts were easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the counterweight was less clear because the description did not show how it sat on the rail.

surprise.text: The weight rail appeared as green end pieces joining the tan bars; I had expected a more distinct rail.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt purposeless, although the wide slot and counterweight placement could be clearer in text.

continue.text: I would not personally continue immediately: the instructions were straightforward, but the mostly prescribed fittings and lack of a moving payoff in this chapter left me only mildly engaged.
